title: Fictional Campus Commute Survey
notice: Synthetic classroom data, not actual students or research findings. A fictional voluntary survey at one school on one morning.

fields.id: Anonymous response identifier; repeated identifiers may be duplicate submissions.
fields.mode: Reported main travel mode. Canonical values: Walk, Bike, Bus.
fields.minutes: Reported one-way travel time in minutes. Blank means missing; negative is invalid.

cleaningRules: Keep the first row for repeated identical response IDs; in a real dataset investigate conflicting repeats.
Exclude records with missing or negative travel time from this analysis; keep an exclusion log.
Keep the 120-minute observation unless there is evidence it is erroneous; flag it as unusual.
